name: Electrical Assemblies Unlimited
old_description: Since 1983, we've built a legacy of expertise. Our seasoned team understands the complexities of manufacturing and distribution, offering you valuable insights to streamline your project and reduce risks.
about:
Electrical Assemblies Unlimited was founded in 1983 in St. Louis, Missouri. The company operates as an electrical contract manufacturer and distributor, building a legacy of expertise over four decades.

The company provides custom cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, control panels, box builds, and printed circuit boards with surface-mount and through-hole technology. It also offers kitting and assembly, in-house engineering, supply chain and inventory management, and certified distribution of components from manufacturers such as Weidmuller. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

EAU serves OEMs in aerospace and space, renewable energy, defense and military, telecommunications, power generation, research laboratories, water and environmental, homeland security, data centers, rail and transit, construction, marine, consumer electronics, medical devices, industrial automation, and automotive. Customers include 24/7 Onsite Cameras, CK Power, and Hubbell Power Systems.

The company emphasizes its in-house engineering, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and decades of experience as differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that helps OEMs solve complex electrical manufacturing challenges with engineering expertise, precision manufacturing, and dependable delivery.
